svg.title: XOR network
svg.desc: Neural network diagram with 3 layers of 2, 2, 1 nodes and 6 connections; connection thickness shows weight magnitude and colour its sign.

g.aria-label: x1 to h1, Weight: 5.1, Colour: red, a positive weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.
g.title: x1 to h1, Weight: 5.1, Colour: red, a positive weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.

g.aria-label: x2 to h1, Weight: -5.2, Colour: blue, a negative weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.
g.title: x2 to h1, Weight: -5.2, Colour: blue, a negative weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.

g.aria-label: x1 to h2, Weight: -4.8, Colour: blue, a negative weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.
g.title: x1 to h2, Weight: -4.8, Colour: blue, a negative weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.

g.aria-label: x2 to h2, Weight: 4.9, Colour: red, a positive weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.
g.title: x2 to h2, Weight: 4.9, Colour: red, a positive weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.

g.aria-label: h1 to xor, Weight: 6.3, Colour: red, a positive weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.
g.title: h1 to xor, Weight: 6.3, Colour: red, a positive weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.

g.aria-label: h2 to xor, Weight: 6.1, Colour: red, a positive weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.
g.title: h2 to xor, Weight: 6.1, Colour: red, a positive weight; thickness shows its magnitude relative to the strongest connection.
